mapper.select: SELECT h.field_id, h.field_task_id, m.field_name AS field_task_name, h.field_result, h.field_start_time, h.field_end_time, h.field_group, h.field_params, h.field_log FROM sys_task_history h LEFT JOIN sys_task_main m ON m.field_id = h.field_task_id WHERE h.field_id = #{fieldId}
